$$
\text{Reduction} = X - \text{2016 Interest Amount}
$$
$$
13 = X - \text{2016 Interest Amount}
$$
$$

$$

But since we don’t have the exact value of `X`, we can only express the 2016 interest amount in terms of the reduction provided. However, the question seems to ask for the absolute value of the 2016 interest amount, which would require knowing the 2015 interest amount. Since this isn't provided, we cannot compute an exact number.

Assume the 2015 interest amount is `A` (unknown), and the 2016 interest amount is `B`.

From the text:
$$

$$
Also,
$$
\frac{13}{A} = 0.23
$$
$$
